notes.title: Heads Will Roll: Reforged - Sins of the Floating City — Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/7bf0f72feda243af1df42f81d5973459d413e37b.jpg[/img]
[b][h1]The fourth major expansion for Heads Will Roll: Reforged has been released![/h1][/b]
[previewyoutube=I0jVrLytCLA;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3857000/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Sins_of_the_Floating_City/

[h2]What awaits you in the DLC:[/h2]
- No step too far, no measure too desperate:
Become the right hand man of the Venetian Doge and plunge headlong into the maelstrom of European politics to help Venice survive the onslaught of an alliance of its many rivals. Enlist the help of allies and defeat your enemies on the battlefield or, through cunning intrigues and sophisticated machinations, set them against each other in order to reap the fruits of their discord. Deception, betrayal, bribery and political assassinations - achieve your goal by any means available and dare to take the most desperate steps for the sake of the greatness of Venice.

- A descent into darkness:
Enter the service of an influential Italian noble house, surrounded by enviers and grudge-bearers, and take on the role of a bodyguard who will protect its members from the dangers that lurk everywhere and the traps set by their enemies. Descend into darkness as you make your way through the Venice's underworld that will confront you with powerful secret societies, mysticism, blood feuds and the many vices and sins of human nature.

- More than a dozen new characters:
From members of various Italian noble houses and famous condottierros to the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire himself.

- Europe-spanning adventure:
Visit Italy, France, Holy Roman Empire and the Outremer all within one continuous campaign.

- 2 new romantic interests:
Each with their own unique story and character.

[h1]Special Offer.[/h1]
To celebrate the release of the new expansion, all previous DLCs are now 50% off
If you’ve been waiting for the best opportunity to grab the game, now is the time: the base game is 75% off.

notes.title: NO MERCY RETRO FPS — Meet HMUR!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/db35c03d0fda7640f3f2aeb39b155175281e3729.jpg[/img]
Greetings to all old-school shooter fans!

Let us introduce HMUR — a fast-paced retro FPS that throws you into a twisted, alternative version of the Soviet Union in the 1990s. Combining the insane mechanics of 90s shooters, Soviet sci-fi aesthetics, and a pounding hardbass soundtrack, the game becomes a relentless dance of speed, precision, and madness.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499560/HMUR/"][/dynamiclink]
You are Sergey, an ordinary worker. Something went terribly wrong, and now your only chance to survive is to be faster than death. [p][/p][p]Be sure to watch the trailer: 
[previewyoutube=zVDyBBJkbxk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]PLAYTEST SIGN-UPS ARE NOW OPEN![/h2]
Want to be among the first to push HMUR to its limits? Sign up for the playtests right now on the game’s Steam page.  
When the playtests begin, you’ll receive a notification.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/c230685cb4e8eca1cb8c821061c7c2fb03d15bc4.jpg[/img]

WHAT AWAITS PLAYTEST PARTICIPANTS:
[list]
[*] One life and endless restarts — in the spirit of Hotline Miami.
[*] Maximum mobility: dodge, jump, flank your enemies.
[*] Non-linear levels — choose your path and adapt your strategy on the fly.
[*] Huge arsenal — shotguns, assault rifles, heavy weapons. But ammo is worth its weight in gold.
[*] Original soundtrack — techno, hardbass, and breakcore merging with the firefight into a single rhythm.
[*] The atmosphere of a secret Soviet facility in the grip of disaster.
[/list]

[h2]🏆 EXCLUSIVE REWARD:[/h2]
Complete the playtest build — and earn an achievement. Upon release, it will turn into a golden pistol skin. This is not just a weapon, but a symbol that you survived where others gave up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/d722637b181d78f5ca45fba4570339a82a764422.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/76bdbfb56a930ee05fad6db4fb7d286628267475.jpg[/img]

[h3]HMUR is created by a solo developer.[/h3]
By participating in the playtests, each of you becomes part of the game’s development story. Join the [url=https://discord.gg/TbvXbvzZTZ]Discord[/url] and become part of the community.

notes.title: Content update DOOMER №1 is available! Changelog post.
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44355443/2152978a1c153df1a05982cbf23fa164c59ddb1d.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=n5YBh0wvxQc;full][/previewyoutube]

Greetings from the Doomer development team! 

We apologize for the long absence of any news and game updates since the announcement of our roadmap. As is often the case, everything that could go wrong went wrong. As we built all the processes and implemented what we promised, it took more time than expected.

Now that the time has come, we are pleased to present you with the first content update, which is quite significant in scope, but represents only a small part of what's planned.

Let's talk about future plans before we get into the details of the update. From now on, we'll release updates more frequently. We can't reveal the content or dates yet, but there won't be such long breaks between updates anymore. In the next step, we'll rework the technical foundation of the game, optimize everything that's "under the hood", and then start developing game mechanics.  

And yes, you read that right, Doomer will feature game mechanics and a clearly defined gameplay cycle. And naturally, we will add more nostalgic items, references, and elements that are signature to the time. 

Sincerely yours, the Doomer team.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/[/url]

Now for the content update:

[h3]1) Character:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Doomer can now run, jump, and crouch; 
[*] When running, the camera wobbles more intensely than when walking; 
[*] Removed camera shake with the option to turn it on if you want to; 
[*] The phone model has been updated to Pokia :), which is more relevant to the time when the game takes place. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/a188f61e42894362f6dbb6bd19c2a4fc4ea0527a.png[/img]

[*] The phone interface has been updated with the ability to call, but no one will answer...yet.
[*] The ability to take photos through the phone has been removed, since it does not correspond to the time of the game. We will get back to this and explore ideas of how to do photos and screenshots later. However, it won't be done with the phone camera, that is for sure.
[*] A redesigned item interaction system has been added. For example, the rat isn't a part of your pocket anymore. It lives in the cage. You can get it out and put it back in.
[*] Like any doomer character can now die, there are several ways to do that. Feel free to experiment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/3e68d2ac9c7474b79bd45d5cb99dbf2d07a1ff5e.png[/img]

[h3]2) Doomers apartment: [/h3]
[list]
[*] You are able to open and close almost all of the doors and windows in the apartment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/5cff5bcf28629d3bccc022a901099b6a09f0aeee.png[/img]

[*] Now, there are switches in all rooms, so lights can be turned on and off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/b3d54fe0f6aa26a5e0e0a21749cc4e7d1b02a681.png[/img]

[*] A gas stove can be lit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/98dfcd234bd4ae7c34de82ee0425524b897f0adf.png[/img]

[*] Lots and lots of authentic items that are appropriate for the time the events of the game take place. Brand new models of items made from scratch, including Dendy consoles, cartridges, videotapes, books, Great Dragon and Technics of Youth magazines, as well as video and audio tape recorders. There is no sense to list it all, just explore and enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/da0d2dc40de74973c52b9f4b9aafbb0ba00a3db3.png[/img]

[*] It is now possible to pick up and inspect items. At the moment, not all of the items are eligible for that, but we will be gradually adding the ability to inspect them all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/d0462bd2891aadd4e39545f58ff27014393bbe9f.png[/img]

[*] You can now watch TV

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/4733d70221e4a1471087a9f3680376decc5c4f2c.png[/img]

[*] The apartment has a telephone now, you should expect a call.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/0d68cd37f25ba3bc4c6c04775a1246941081907a.png[/img]

[*] There has been a change in the apartment's furnishings. Now that Doomer has a new table, he has rearranged some stuff around the apartment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/a0829a33c001b6476d352c65d53fc1b5737e4da3.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3]3) Other: [/h3]
[list]
[*] The apartment building has the entrance now, you can access it from the doomers apartment. It allows you to go out onto the street, or access the roof. We attempted to make the entrance as authentic as possible using relevant objects and attributes of the time, writings on the walls, ashtrays, bottles, etc. You can explore, ring your neighbors doorbells and find ways to entertain yourself, maybe getting an achievement or two while you are at it. We'll add more activities over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/21af654deca04ab7b71da3c2f58b8e0c5866fc48.png[/img]

[*] You can access the roof now. There you can walk around, smoke a cigarette and contemplate about your life while looking at the surrounding landscape from above. That, and all other sorts of activities you can think of.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/ed588cf12a3e2d49c65d176816eb067478b96803.png[/img]

[*] The lighting has been updated, smoothly transitioning to dynamic lighting;
[*] A variety of ambient sounds, clocks, birds outside the window, street noise, computer startup, and others have been added;
[*] Picked bottles can be thrown anywhere if you click the left mouse button after picking them up. Give it a try, experiment with it...
[*] The railroad in the area is now fully operational. Watch the departing train doomer and think about life...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/22e9c53431eab3db83538a30e8ebaa4288659f6a.png[/img]

[*] There are many hidden activities now. We won't reveal them, but we are sure you'll enjoy finding them. Don't be afraid to explore the neighborhood and the apartment, something interesting is surely waiting for you there.
[*] Lines 97 is now installed on the computer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/148831f1c301faefebc99afe8b59060462602009.png[/img]

[*] Several parked cars appeared on the streets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/f6c1c58ff973e05e6ba858dcb99dbe29dbb768d2.png[/img]

[*] The apartment buildings themselves were embellished with authentic external elements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/39c98f3492ff6d169f16dc25766b04390af4f81d.png[/img]

[*] Old achievements have been remade to match the spirit of the game and the changes we've made. You'll find new secret achievements as well, look for ways to unlock them and just have fun.  
[/list]

[h3]Enjoy the game!!![/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/[/url]

notes.title: Huge update for Zombie Road Rider! New maps and new zombies!
notes.content:
Hi people!

[b]Zombie Road Rider[/b] has received a [b]huge update[/b] that was on the work for some times now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175640/Zombie_Road_Rider/

Actually, the game has received a series of updates since the last news that was posted last year ago! So what is new?

A full new environment to play! The [b]City Downtown[/b] ! Set in an environment made of skyscrapers and large roads, save the survivors who are running around and bring them to the safe house!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/95a0d1b7264481b6ac5e137bf3a7d2fe666b76aa.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/8f4e97a8c6bfae9a50ea725db8a7de4d3c9d0064.jpg[/img]

Another new environment, the [b]Industrial Town[/b]! Set in narrow streets with old industrial style buildings, largely populated with fully physics-based props, obstacles and zombies to road ride!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/98f1e6fe837711a742a3775547dfccf23bc79310.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/fee8a8ddef73791dcacdc55f7d52fc7fca266e03.jpg[/img]

[b]The Factory[/b], a modern industrial type place with barricades and zombies to destroy!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/ade6a5df7052809be50173755ebab3f195d6ac41.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/a7e51c4dc1321136d3d203c7e5a49f4ee1aa8802.jpg[/img]

Another one main new aspect of the game is that [b]+30 zombies were added [/b]to replace the old classic one, so that the game has more variety of characters!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/d026c4dfa1436d565e546f9a344a423bbf313c46.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/79c36fe1d10ef8ab1a5221af2a1626267cdd9578.jpg[/img]

[b]Physics of the cars and vehicles were reworked[/b] to feel more enjoyable and powerful against the obstacles and zombies on the road. Improvements were made on the graphics and the optimisation of the game to have it run more smoothly. The menu and user interface was also reworked to be more intuitive and easier to use.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0qe6t-gvPVg

The environments that were added have support for both rescue and freeride game mode!

So this pretty sum up all what you will find in this large update! I hope you will enjoy!

Best,
Devdan

notes.title: New gameplay update for Aerial Destruction
notes.content:
After a quite long break with the development of the game, an update has been released for [b]Aerial Destruction[/b] which improves the gameplay experience, add new features and fixes some bugs.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/d57635976216f9b6f4fc4f6ea5cbd9c1199da918.jpg[/img]

What was added is the [b]ability to enable or disable the helicopter sensor[/b] which displays red squares over enemy units as much as green squares over allied units.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/d6f2858c2bc2307af5c71a8fde2a0273f281482d.jpg[/img]

While this sensor is helpful to have a clear view over all units on the map when flying at high attitude, it may sometimes hurt the immersion of the game by giving the feeling of shooting over colored squares instead of troops and vehicles.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/3db997f0640b2a036a869297134c9cec6d1357e7.jpg[/img]

For this reason, you can now enable or disable the sensor depending of your preferences !

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/b16a0ad9700eaeaff937b38655bab042ac57a075.jpg[/img]

What was also done is the ability to [b]turn on or off the in-game musics[/b], wherever you want to listen to your own musics instead while playing, or if you simply want to play without musics.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/188d0d3c1cdf97e4f4c2b4012d19d06b2f3d93ca.jpg[/img]

Works were also done on the [b]enemy units[/b] to improve their [b]animations[/b] and to make them holding their machines guns and rocket launchers the right way. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/18ccfdbd6c890e8a3ed7c72ae5e858eaea2ae952.jpg[/img]

The [b]ragdoll physics[/b] were also improved in a way that it gives a better feeling of bullet impacts when firing at them from your helicopter's machine gun.

Finally, the menu was improved with a dynamic scene of the game used as the menu background.

So that's pretty much all, thank you for reading !

[i]Devdan[/i]
http://devdangames.com

notes.title: Update and optimisations for Aerial Destruction
notes.content:
A new update has recently been added to the game which fix some flaws in the gameplay and optimise the graphics to improve the framerate during combats against the mutants.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/3817f9d7c69bf58fc5ad05d63756c33833a2e97f.jpg[/img]

To optimise the game, work has been done especially toward the units moving on the ground, by creating better level of details (LODs) for them. This has greatly reduced the amount of polygons rendered when fighting the large groups of mutants present in many missions.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/ab5873266506d56158f2e1dc996cdf20dd6d5a37.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/81928669900e1b6688ea2ca532ff4be92e03593d.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/c9cae0b0aa6420fe37f92be392e6206b4a78a5a5.jpg[/img]
  
Along the improved LODs, there has also been some work done on the code of the artificial intelligence to reduce the use of CPU when the mutants are searching for targets and are moving around the map.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/8637b2555a858875b4b7753f6b2b11792d1b5603.jpg[/img]

While these optimisations are quite effective, more improvements will have to be done in the future to achieve the optimal framerate during the most crowded battles.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/001e14db1148c2bf4b74023a5f9e5cd72eb15d22.jpg[/img]

The upgrade system which could give overpowered and invincible helicopters after playing for enough time was also fixed. It will now give a more intensive gameplay after completing all the missions, rather than an unbalanced god mode which could hurt the playing experience.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/ca7676fcc0da3556d18c250e2f6bdd78e13e950b.jpg[/img]

An annoying bug in the Frontline Assault map was also fixed, where sometimes the action would be stuck when the assault of the allied troops was not triggered even after destroying the mutant fortifications. While this issue did not appeared on all installations of the game, many users have been reporting this on the forum, therefore the entire event system of this mission had to be rewritten and this has hopefully solved the issue.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/75b07c7aa24872bd0e45c1fd701c54e458713e9b.jpg[/img]

In brief, here is the changelog for this update :
[list]
    [*]Fixed gameplay events sometimes not being triggered in the "Frontline Assault" mission.
    [*]Fixed the "Camp Defence" mission where too many mutants were spawning at the end, giving lag spikes and framerate issues.
    [*]Fixed the upgrade system of the helicopters to prevent it from making the game too easy when upgrading the helicopters.
    [*]Optimisation for the mutants infantry and vehicles.
    [*]Optimisations for the AI.
    [*]Added icon and game name in the game's process
    [*]Minor improvements.
[/list]

Thank you for reading. 
Devdan
[url]http://devdangames.com[/url]

notes.title: Update and optimisations for Aerial Destruction
notes.content:
A new update has recently been added to the game which fix some flaws in the gameplay and optimise the graphics to improve the framerate during combats against the mutants.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/3817f9d7c69bf58fc5ad05d63756c33833a2e97f.jpg[/img]

To optimise the game, work has been done especially toward the units moving on the ground, by creating better level of details (LODs) for them. This has greatly reduced the amount of polygons rendered when fighting the large groups of mutants present in many missions.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/ab5873266506d56158f2e1dc996cdf20dd6d5a37.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/81928669900e1b6688ea2ca532ff4be92e03593d.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/c9cae0b0aa6420fe37f92be392e6206b4a78a5a5.jpg[/img]
  
Along the improved LODs, there has also been some work done on the code of the artificial intelligence to reduce the use of CPU when the mutants are searching for targets and are moving around the map.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/8637b2555a858875b4b7753f6b2b11792d1b5603.jpg[/img]

While these optimisations are quite effective, more improvements will have to be done in the future to achieve the optimal framerate during the most crowded battles.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/001e14db1148c2bf4b74023a5f9e5cd72eb15d22.jpg[/img]

The upgrade system which could give overpowered and invincible helicopters after playing for enough time was also fixed. It will now give a more intensive gameplay after completing all the missions, rather than an unbalanced god mode which could hurt the playing experience.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/ca7676fcc0da3556d18c250e2f6bdd78e13e950b.jpg[/img]

An annoying bug in the Frontline Assault map was also fixed, where sometimes the action would be stuck when the assault of the allied troops was not triggered even after destroying the mutant fortifications. While this issue did not appeared on all installations of the game, many users have been reporting this on the forum, therefore the entire event system of this mission had to be rewritten and this has hopefully solved the issue.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/75b07c7aa24872bd0e45c1fd701c54e458713e9b.jpg[/img]

In brief, here is the changelog for this update :
[list]
    [*]Fixed gameplay events sometimes not being triggered in the "Frontline Assault" mission.
    [*]Fixed the "Camp Defence" mission where too many mutants were spawning at the end, giving lag spikes and framerate issues.
    [*]Fixed the upgrade system of the helicopters to prevent it from making the game too easy when upgrading the helicopters.
    [*]Optimisation for the mutants infantry and vehicles.
    [*]Optimisations for the AI.
    [*]Added icon and game name in the game's process
    [*]Minor improvements.
[/list]

Thank you for reading. 
Devdan
[url]http://devdangames.com[/url]

notes.title: Major update ! Missions, upgrade system and gameplay fixes
notes.content:
[b][i]Aerial Destruction[/i][/b] has recently received a major update which adds one new mission and many new features.

The new mission named "Frontline Assault" is set during an assault where the allied militaries are attempting to destroy a mutant base. The player will have to destroy the many fortified positions surrounding the base before launching with the allied units the final strike on the base itself.

With this new mission, the game is now consisting in [b]7 missions[/b], each one playable with the [b]3 helicopters[/b] available in the game. After completing a mission, the helicopter of the mission is unlocked for all the other ones. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/39a0de16a61396ad3a5bdf69cda14c66658f6776.jpg[/img]
[i]Outpost Invasion[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/03817e6552121d6da8e44149dacc2c7efd425149.jpg[/img]
[i]Bridge Destruction[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/35150d88587ba68a976801b744479c4ac024786e.jpg[/img]
[i]Frontline Assault[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/5b92d8c5f9dee2886780344795ed078f3b85ac13.jpg[/img]
[i]Convoy Support[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/b5014698441e12a3da8ee583ba29669b3f06943c.jpg[/img]
[i]Volcanic Island[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/ec34a006fdc6201c8da2fd65007fb9b4792d4a9a.jpg[/img]
[i]Ancient Ruins[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/56695ec494ff0353908c36decae898207e4f03c7.jpg[/img]
[i]Camp Defence[/i] (defend for as long as possible)

Controls of the helicopters were improved so that each one gives a more different playing experience. The small helicopter is now lighter and much more manoeuvrable, while the heavy helicopters can fly faster and can take more damages.

Along this, an upgrade system has been added to the game. With credits point earned while playing, it makes possible to upgrade in an unlimited way the helicopters armaments and fire power to achieve maximum destruction !

Last, there are many minor bugs which were fixed and adjustments made to improve the gameplay.

Thanks for reading,
[i]Devdan[/i]

notes.title: Firing power and destruction increasement
notes.content:
The game has received a small update which greatly improves the accuracy, firing power and destructivity of the helicopters.

Here is a list of the changes and fixes:
 [list]
    [*]Fixed the impact of miniguns and 30mm cannons being a little bit offset from the crosshair. 
    [*][b]Miniguns[/b] are now deadlier to mutant infantry and vehicles, with a higher radius of damage.
    [*][b]Rockets[/b] are now much more faster, are more explosive and inflict more damages.
    [*][b]Missiles[/b] are travelling faster and can now wipe out entire convoys of mutants.
    [*][b]Resupply zones[/b] are now resupplying cartridges and rockets much more quickly.
    [*]Fixed the cartridges ammo count which was always leaving one unusable cartridge.
    [*]Fixed the ammo and damages warning message sometimes not being displayed.
    [*]Fixed the MH-6 collision boxes.
    [*][b]Helicopters[/b] can now fly at higher speed.
[/list] 

The update should apply instantly, more tweaks are planned for the gameplay so don't hesitate to let me know what you think.

Thanks for reading,
[i]Devdan[/i]

notes.title: Controls improvements and minor fixes
notes.content:
With the initial controls closer to a realistic flying simulator, the helicopters were quite hard to pilot and could require a lot of time to learn and be efficient with them.

It is why improvements were made to make the game more playable and easy to handle to avoid giving a frustrating experience of helicopter crashing.

[b]It is now much easier to control the altitude and direction, therefore giving more accuracy and stability when firing at grounded targets.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/8a31985ff28a7fd5032f1a0efad69b61332d1fc7.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/657ed205aab7948488939be2aa68736557d61690.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/e41ebbe240fb8f1469216fc5dd392d37b7e294e1.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/6fd4a4473bcd500a133009de4f83a44dc5a2322a.jpg[/img]

The helicopter holds its altitude when flying so it is less prone to crashing when manoeuvring to dodge enemy fire. Here is a video showing the difference between the new and initial controls :
https://youtu.be/wwh6Jz5e7p8
[b]A new control system has also been made for the cockpit view[/b], where the helicopter is mostly controlled with the keyboard and the [b]firing aim is manually done with the mouse.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/a23ddf34a4795151fdb5b701859b3e94bbc0a1a6.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/957b3fe9511c01547966577922c135f4521dd0cb.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/dba707806050df32dea542e9609e96039e03f59d.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27776825/35e1a79ca885cf892dd6d7b8d40ef899b62cf303.jpg[/img]

Regarding the initial controls system, it is now unavailable in the current version but will be improved and brought back in a future update, so [b]the game will have 2 different controls system, arcade and realistic.[/b]

Although, for those willing to [b]try the realistic piloting controls now, it is still possible by switching the release branch. Open the properties window of the game in the Steam client and check to the "BETAS" tab.[/b]

Along this update, here are the minor fixes :
[list]
    [*]Fixed and improved options to tweak the mouse sensitivity
    [*]Added an option to invert mouse
    [*]Added support for 21:9 screens (2560x1080)
[/list] 

Thanks for reading,
[i]Devdan[/i]

notes.title: Early Access launch and clarifications about gameplay controls.
notes.content:
Following almost a year of development, Aerial destruction has just been launched as an Early Access and is now available to play.

Many tweaks are still being made and some updates with fixes should come soon, including more contents. In the meanwhile, there seems to be some difficulties with handling the gameplay controls which I would like to explain here.

The controls for helicopters in Aerial Destruction is an attempt to be close to reality, which means it doesn't work like a first person shooter with W moving forward and A-D strafing left and right.

Instead the keys are mostly used to give engine power to the helicopter and the rest is done with the mouse.

The keys are mapped such as bellow :
[b]W = Lift / Accelerate
S = Descend / Decelerate
A = Turn Left
D = Turn Right[/b]

The mouse is mean to be used as a joystick :
[b]Mouse Forward = Roll Forward[/b] (nose of the helicopter points down - advance)
[b]Mouse Backward = Roll Backward[/b] (nose of the helicopter points upper - slow down)
[b]Mouse Left = Barrel Roll Left 
Mouse Right = Barrel  Roll Right[/b]

Don't brutally push the mouse or you will loose control of the helicopter.

Piloting the helicopters requires pressing [b]W to raise the helicopter in the air, then slowly move the mouse forward to have the helicopter rotate forward and start advancing.[/b]

[b]The helicopter will keep rotating forward so move the mouse back to normal to stop the rotation when it is enough.[/b] To slow down the helicopter its the same excepted the mouse must be moved backward and then returned.

One last thing to say is that the [b]cockpit view is the easiest and best to control[/b], especially when beginning, while the behind view is nice to have an overview of the helicopter but can be hard sometimes to aim accurately.

When handled, these controls give a more intensive and immersive gameplay experience, but I will see if it is possible to implement a more airboat-like control in a next update.

Thanks for reading,
[i]Devdan[/i]
